verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a local CLI secret scanner. Secret-scanning products could plausibly offer an API with scoped credentials, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no credential-issuance or scoping feature. The token gitleaks-action uses to comment on PRs is a GitHub-platform token, not something Gitleaks issues. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
